note: An example suite for a made-up game: a farm where the player waters crops and sells them at a stall. Write your own prompts about your game; 'expected' is the answer a correct run gives, checked by hand.

prompts.prompt: Verify that watering a planted seed makes it grow into a crop
Verify that the watering can holds at most 10 uses before it must be refilled
Sell three crops at the stall
